title: add RAG templates, agent/tool-calling quickstarts, and docs site updates
author: Ava Chen
commits: feat(docs): add RAG overview and templates for basic and agent-tool-calling flows
feat(examples): add python and typescript agent tool-calling quickstarts
test(integration): add smoke tests for rag quickstarts
chore(docs): update website sidebar and versioned docs
ci(docs): add link validator and fix discovered broken links
description: Context: Customers and internal teams increasingly ask for drop-in RAG templates and opinionated agent examples that demonstrate safe tool-calling patterns with Redwood. This PR adds a set of RAG templates, agent quickstarts (Python + TypeScript), example projects, and accompanying docs site updates so users can try RAG + agents end-to-end. Motivation: lower friction for developers to adopt RAG and tool-calling patterns with Redwood by providing runnable examples and concise guides. What changed: - docs/guides/rag/overview.md: new top-level guide explaining when to use RAG vs direct prompts, tradeoffs, and recommended templates. - docs/guides/rag/templates/*: three opinionated templates (basic, memory-enabled, agent-tool-calling) with config snippets and recommended eval prompts. - docs/quickstarts/agents/*: two quickstarts (Python, TypeScript) with step-by-step run instructions, env setup, and expected output. - examples/rag/...: runnable example projects that wire the templates into a small agent that calls a simulated search tool and a ticketing API (mocked). - tests/integration/test_rag_quickstarts.py: a smoke test that runs the python quickstart in CI mode. - website/sidebar.json and versioned docs: surface quickstarts in the docs nav and add redirects. - mkdocs.yml and scripts/ci/validate-docs-links.sh: small doc build helpers and a new CI step to catch broken links. Checklist: - [x] Add templates and examples - [x] Add docs pages and quickstarts - [x] Add integration smoke test - [x] Validate docs build and fix link issues - [x] Run CI and address lint failures Backwards compatibility: docs and examples only; no runtime API changes. Risks/notes: - Example agent includes a simulated "search" tool that returns canned results; we explicitly document how to swap in a production search index. - We added minimal dependencies in examples; instructions show how to pin versions. Release notes: adds RAG templates and agent quickstarts to docs and examples.
